servicesPage.intro: At Dallas Auto Service, we offer a full range of auto repair and maintenance services to keep your vehicle running smoothly. From routine oil changes to complex engine repairs, our certified technicians have you covered.

services.title: Brake Repair & Replacement
services.shortDescription: Expert brake services to ensure your safety on the road.
services.longDescription: Your brakes are the most critical safety component of your vehicle. We inspect, repair, and replace brake pads, rotors, calipers, and lines using high-quality parts. Our technicians ensure your braking system performs optimally.
benefits: Peace of mind with thorough inspections

process.title: Inspection
process.description: We perform a comprehensive brake inspection, measuring pad thickness, rotor condition, and fluid levels.

process.title: Repair or Replace
process.description: Based on findings, we replace worn parts with OEM-grade components and machine rotors if needed.

process.title: Test Drive
process.description: We test drive your vehicle to ensure brakes are responsive and quiet before returning it to you.

faqs.question: How often should I replace my brake pads?
faqs.answer: Typically every 30,000 to 70,000 miles depending on driving habits. We recommend an inspection every 10,000 miles.

faqs.question: What are signs of brake problems?
faqs.answer: Squealing, grinding, vibration, or a spongy brake pedal. If you notice any of these, bring your car in immediately.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Advanced diagnostics to pinpoint and fix engine issues.
services.longDescription: When your check engine light comes on or your car isn't performing as it should, our diagnostic tools quickly identify the problem. We handle everything from sensor replacements to major engine overhauls.

process.title: Scan & Analyze
process.description: We connect your vehicle to our diagnostic computer to read error codes and analyze data.

process.title: In-Depth Inspection
process.description: Our technician performs a visual and mechanical inspection to confirm the issue.

process.title: Repair & Verify
process.description: We complete the repair and re-scan to ensure the problem is resolved.

faqs.question: Why is my check engine light on?
faqs.answer: It can be anything from a loose gas cap to a serious engine issue. We recommend a diagnostic scan to find out.

faqs.question: How long does an engine diagnostic take?
faqs.answer: Typically 30-60 minutes. We'll provide a detailed report of findings and recommended repairs.

services.title: Oil Change & Routine Maintenance
services.shortDescription: Keep your engine running smoothly with regular maintenance.
services.longDescription: Regular oil changes and maintenance are essential for your vehicle's longevity. We use premium oils and filters, and our multi-point inspection catches potential issues early.

process.title: Oil Drain & Refill
process.description: We drain old oil, replace the filter, and refill with the correct grade of oil for your vehicle.

process.title: Multi-Point Inspection
process.description: We check fluids, belts, hoses, tires, and brakes to identify any concerns.

process.title: Reset & Report
process.description: We reset your oil life monitor and provide a detailed report of your vehicle's condition.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Conventional oil every 3,000-5,000 miles; synthetic oil every 5,000-7,500 miles. Check your owner's manual.

faqs.question: What does a multi-point inspection include?
faqs.answer: We check tire pressure and tread, fluid levels, belts, hoses, battery, lights, and wipers.

services.title: AC & Heating System Service
services.shortDescription: Stay comfortable with expert AC and heating repairs.
services.longDescription: A working HVAC system is crucial for comfort and safety. We diagnose and repair air conditioning, heating, and defroster issues, ensuring your cabin stays comfortable year-round.

process.title: System Check
process.description: We test refrigerant levels, compressor function, and airflow to identify the problem.

process.title: Repair or Recharge
process.description: We repair leaks, replace faulty components, or recharge refrigerant to restore performance.

process.title: Performance Test
process.description: We run the system to ensure it cools or heats effectively and check for any remaining issues.

faqs.question: Why is my AC blowing warm air?
faqs.answer: Common causes include low refrigerant, a faulty compressor, or a clogged condenser. We'll diagnose and fix it.

faqs.question: How often should I service my car's AC?
faqs.answer: We recommend an AC check every two years to maintain efficiency and catch small issues early.

about.headline: About Dallas Auto Service
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality auto repair in Dallas, TX, with a focus on customer satisfaction and transparency.
story: Founded in 1995, Dallas Auto Service started as a small garage with a big mission: to offer reliable auto repair without the dealer price tag. Our founder, a lifelong mechanic, built the business on a foundation of trust and technical expertise. Over the years, we've grown into a full-service repair shop serving thousands of customers across Dallas.

Today, our team of ASE-certified technicians continues that legacy. We invest in the latest diagnostic tools and ongoing training to service all makes and models. Whether it's a simple oil change or a complex engine rebuild, we treat every car as if it were our own. Our 4.9-star rating and countless referrals are a testament to our commitment.
